text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging @oncall-sre — dedicated pool auric-prod-pool-1 GPU saturation 95% for 12m, queue_length rising, affected_tenant=auric-systems
sre_olivia: I'm on it — joining, pulling metrics now
infra_raj: oncall infra here, grabbing node and autoscaler logs
sre_olivia: metrics: tenant queue delta +42k reqs, p95 latency 1.2s -> 4.8s, instance utilization 98%, autoscaler shows min_replicas=2, max_replicas=10, current_replicas=10 (hit cap)
infra_raj: autoscaler cap hit — policy prevented scale beyond 10 due to cost cap set by finance
eng_platform_marc: fyi we have shared-burst-gpus pool available (4x A100) for temporary overrides
sre_olivia: options: 1) trigger burst override to attach 4 GPUs to auric-prod-pool-1 for 30m 2) increase autoscaler max to 14 (slow to provision) 3) evict low-priority jobs from tenant (risky for customer-run batch jobs)
product_ps: need customer impact assessment before evicting anything — what's the degraded surface?
tc_gina: I'm oncall for Auric Systems — I can call them now. Their webhooks are degraded, some user reports of timeouts.
sre_olivia: recommend: burst override immediately + bump autoscaler max to 14 as backup. Also enable tenant-queue-priority eviction for non-urgent jobs if queue doesn't drop in 10m. Approve?
eng_platform_marc: approve. executing now:
```
/run-burst --pool auric-prod-pool-1 --source shared-burst-gpus --gpus 4 --duration 30m --reason "tenant-exhaustion-auric"
```
incident-bot: run-burst job started (job_id: rb-20260317-871), attaching 4 GPUs, estimated attach time 90s
sre_olivia: monitoring... queue_length dropping 60% after attach, p95 back to 1.5s
tc_gina: called customer rep Emma — informed them of temporary burst, Emma appreciates proactive alerting. They report degraded UX improved after ~7m
infra_raj: bumping autoscaler max to 14 now; command:
```
kubectl patch hpa auric-prod-pool-1 -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":14}}'
```
infra_raj: autoscaler change accepted, new max=14
sre_olivia: set eviction policy: drain low-priority work from auric-prod-pool-1 if queue delta > 20k for 5m (will avoid batch evictions for now)
eng_platform_marc: note: burst will incur on-demand cost, finance notified via slack #finance-alerts
sre_olivia: plan: keep burst for 30m, watch queues, if steady we scale down and revert autoscaler max to 10 in 1h. Create post-incident to adjust min_replicas and add alert for tenant queue delta crossing autoscaler cap.
product_ps: confirm customer impact: partial degradation for 12m window, no data loss, customer notified
sre_olivia: handing off to night oncall @sre_jamal in 20m. Summary: burst override + autoscaler max bump + eviction policy set + customer notified. Actions for follow-up: audit autoscaler thresholds, consider tenant-specific cost accounting, update runbook.
sre_jamal: acknowledged, will take watch at handoff and follow up on post-incident
sre_olivia: closing incident channel for active mitigation but keeping watch for 1h — :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: reminder scheduled — revert autoscaler max to 10 in 1h unless cleared
sre_jamal: will confirm revert or extend if needed
